## Source discovery and admission audits

The 2026-08-16 source program was completed through pull request #91, which added five fresh cross-platform/community discovery targets to a WebNR-maintained link-only starter: Top Web Fiction, SpaceBattles Discover Stories, Sufficient Velocity Story Library, Reddit Serials Story Directory, and r/HFY.

- **Top Web Fiction — pass link-only.** Current public evidence identifies a community-run online-serial/indie-fiction listing with reader boosts, weekly/all-time views, tags, and new listings. Keep only the landing URL and WebNR-authored discovery metadata.
- **SpaceBattles — pass link-only.** The public story library spans original and fan fiction; site rules/terms govern user-generated content and creator rights. Keep discovery links only; no story/thread/comment/profile ingestion.
- **Sufficient Velocity — pass link-only.** The Story Library exposes tags, status, word count, forum, and original-fiction filters. Keep discovery links only; any richer adapter needs explicit rights/access and machine-interface fixtures.
- **Reddit Serials — bounded pass link-only.** The community-maintained ongoing-serial directory remains useful as a landing-page index, but readers should confirm each work's current origin/status.
- **r/HFY — bounded pass link-only.** Retain the public community entry only; do not copy posts, comments, author indexes, or story text.

A secondary queue was also identified for future audit: LitFic public catalog/RSS, Betakyte serialized-fiction feeds, Hungry's Hedgerow author-site RSS, Ream's free/paid serial-fiction platform, and Laterpress serial-fiction surfaces. They remain research leads until rights/access, stable identity, paging/feed semantics, cadence, attribution, and update behavior are reproducibly specified.

Pull request #91 passed its full Quality gate and was squash-merged as `129b2604b76261c42da6838cd649af4f127335fd`. Its application deployment run `31959760701` published that exact reader artifact, including the `english-web-fiction-discovery-starter` output.
